<section class="grignan-home">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.grignan-home {
  display: block !important;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.grignan-home * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRE DOSSIER & INTRODUCTION
===================================== */

.gh-dossier-title {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 35px 0 34px;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  background: #f0f7ed;
  border: 2px solid #b7d7ad;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(56, 118, 60, 0.08);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.gh-dossier-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  right: -14px;
  bottom: -16px;
  width: 210px;
  height: 210px;
  opacity: 0.10;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
}

.gh-dossier-title > *:not(.gh-dossier-hero-bg) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.gh-section-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 5px 13px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #d8ebd2;
  color: #38662e;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 30px !important;
  color: #26394d !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.gh-dossier-title p {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #4a5568;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 680px;
}

/* =====================================
   GRILLE DES 3 ENCADRÉS CARRÉS DU HAUT
===================================== */

.grignan-home .shots-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 20px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
}

.grignan-home .shot-card {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: flex-start !important;
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  padding: 20px !important;
  background: #f7f8f8 !important;
  border: 1px solid #d5e2d2 !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(41, 55, 71, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.grignan-home .shot-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(41,55,71,0.08);
}

.shot-meta {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}

.shot-number {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #38662e;
}

.shot-number--ochre {
  color: #967337;
}

.shot-number--blue {
  color: #385d7d;
}

.shot-tag {
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #e3efe0;
  color: #38662e;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shot-tag--ochre {
  background: #f8f1e5;
  color: #967337;
}

.shot-tag--blue {
  background: #edf3f8;
  color: #385d7d;
}

.shot-frame {
  width: 100% !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
  padding: 8px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #d9e4d6 !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
}

.shot-frame svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 88px;
}

.grignan-home .shot-card h2 {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #293747 !important;
  margin: 0 0 8px !important;
  padding: 0 0 6px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e9ec !important;
  float: none !important;
}

.shot-desc {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  color: #435264 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* =====================================
   4e ENCADRÉ HORIZONTAL EN DESSOUS (PLEINE LARGEUR)
===================================== */

.grignan-home .archives-horizontal-card {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  margin-top: 20px !important;
  gap: 20px !important;
  padding: 18px 22px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbf7ef 0%, #f5ede0 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid #dcc7a1 !important;
  border-left: 5px solid #c39a54 !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(150, 115, 55, 0.08);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.grignan-home .archives-horizontal-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(150, 115, 55, 0.12);
}

.archives-illustration {
  flex: 0 0 82px !important;
  width: 82px !important;
  height: 68px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #e4d4b7 !important;
  border-radius: 9px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  padding: 5px !important;
}

.archives-illustration svg {
  width: 68px;
  height: 54px;
  display: block;
}

.archives-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
}

.archives-header-row {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
}

.grignan-home .archives-body h3 {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: auto !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.3 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #4a3819 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.archives-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.7px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #967337;
  background: #efe3ce;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.archives-body p {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  color: #5b492c !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* SÉPARATION */

.elus-separator {
  margin: 34px 0 28px;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #e1e5e7;
}

/* =====================================
   GUIDE PRATIQUE & LÉGENDE À COPIER
===================================== */

.methodology {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  color: #293747;
}

.methodology-letter {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 794px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 38px 46px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e8eb;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(41,55,71,0.07);
}

.methodology-header {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #dce2e8;
}

.methodology-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
}

.methodology-icon-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.grignan-home .methodology-title h2 {
  display: block !important;
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  color: #293f56 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  float: none !important;
  text-indent: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.methodology-section {
  display: flex;
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 12px 15px;
  margin-bottom: 11px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border-left: 5px solid;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.methodology-number {
  min-width: 28px;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 13px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: white;
}

.methodology-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.grignan-home .methodology-content h3 {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  margin: 1px 0 4px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  font-weight: bold !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.methodology-content p {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0;
  color: #435264;
}

.method-teal {
  background: #eaf4f2;
  border-color: #5d978b;
}

.method-teal .methodology-number {
  background: #5d978b;
}

.method-teal h3 {
  color: #39766b !important;
}

.method-ochre {
  background: #f8f1e5;
  border-color: #c39a54;
}

.method-ochre .methodology-number {
  background: #c39a54;
}

.method-ochre h3 {

}

.method-blue {

}

.method-blue .methodology-number {
  background: #547b9f;
}

.method-blue h3 {
  color: #385d7d !important;
}

/* LÉGENDE PRÊTE À COPIER */

.caption-box {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  background: #fdfcf9;
  border: 1.5px dashed #568239;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.caption-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.caption-title {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #293f56;
  margin: 0;
}

.caption-note {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #38662e;
  background: #e3efe0;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.caption-sample {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #dce2e8;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #293747;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  white-space: pre-line;
}

.caption-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
}

.caption-feedback {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #38662e;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.caption-feedback.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

.caption-copy-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 8px 15px;
  background-color: #568239;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.caption-copy-btn:hover {
  background-color: #43692B;
}

.methodology-footer {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce2e8;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #82909d;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .grignan-home .shots-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    gap: 16px !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
    font-size: 24px !important;
  }

  .gh-dossier-hero-bg {
    width: 150px;

  }

  .gh-dossier-title p {

    padding: 0 10px;
  }

  .methodology-letter {

  }

  .grignan-home .methodology-title h2 {
    font-size: 17px !important;
  }

  .grignan-home .archives-horizontal-card {
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: flex-start !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}
</style>

    <h2>Vue d’ensemble</h2>

      <div class="caption-sample" id="legende-reseaux">Voici l’entrée actuelle de l’ancien Four banal de Grignan (Drôme), inaugurée en septembre 2026 pour les 400 ans de Madame de Sévigné.

Un gigantesque portail et une grille représentant la Marquise avec une tête déformée et la robe percée transforment ce lieu historique. Une commande publique de 200 000 € réalisée sans consultation des habitants et en toute illégalité car aucune demande préalable à l’ABF n'a été effectuée.

Est-ce vraiment en adéquation avec l’esprit du Four banal et l’identité de Grignan ?

#Grignan #FourBanal #Patrimoine #MadameDeSévigné #DrômeProvençale</div>

<script>
function copierLegende() {
  const texteElement = document.getElementById('legende-reseaux');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('caption-feedback');
  if (!texteElement) return;

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(texteElement.innerText.trim()).then(() => {
    if (feedback) {
      feedback.classList.add('is-visible');
      setTimeout(() => feedback.classList.remove('is-visible'), 2500);
    }
  });
}
</script>

</section>
